ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio of approximately 1:12; high contrast is concentrated at anomaly sites and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation covering >90% of surface; distinct high-intensity focal points include a circular ring at the mid-left lobe and dense, irregular white clusters at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree angle; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration profile along the trailing edge; prominent jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes across the entire linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory along the trailing edge, curving sharply upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular and hemispherical high-contrast clusters at the extreme left and right lateral tips; single distinct white circular ring (rosette) on the lower-left fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions; prominent vertical rake marks on the inner-right lobe and diagonal scratches on the outer-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at distal tips; multiple linear rake marks across the ventral surface and a distinct circular scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular white ring-shaped mark located in the mid-ventral region of the left lobe.
